goal: Use the approved V16 Lucas voice as the canonical French target for new dialogue while preserving its timbre, tone and fluidity.

french_delivery.register: young adult male, naturally low, never forced downward
french_delivery.tone: warm, intimate, calm, close and effortless
french_delivery.timbre: compact, soft slightly husky texture with smooth low-mid body and natural imperfect edges
french_delivery.phrasing: continuous conversational French with natural linking and no perceptible clause reset
french_delivery.pauses: tiny irregular breath-sized micro-pauses only when needed; no dead air
french_delivery.attacks: soft, with no hard word-by-word resets
french_delivery.consonants: relaxed and clear without clipped or percussive diction

reference_test_line: Je viens de me poser deux minutes et toi tu fais quoi ?
approval: V16 approved for Lucas French timbre, tone and fluidity. New dialogue must preserve this voice direction.
